correctness.rationale: Each fine-grid interval of angular width b=2π/m contains at most one coarse normal. Modulo b, the n coarse residues form q=n/gcd(n,m) equally spaced offsets occurring d times; this gives exact gap list and identity E_f=(m−n)f(b)+d∑[f(kh−t)+f((q−k)h+t)] including collision phases f(0)=0. Symmetry and strict convexity yield unique midpoint min and aligned max, without assuming f is increasing. A circumscribed tangential polygon has area r²∑tan(g/2). Uniform angular phase and integral of tan yield claimed mean and CDF; Taylor at minimizing phase and derivative at maximum establish density endpoint laws; cubic power-sum identity yields π³r²d²/(4nm³)+O_n(m^-5) for fixed n. Independent direct merged-normal computation across 280 (n,m,t) configurations matched formula with maximum absolute rounding discrepancy 3.55e-14; these checks supplement proof.
